changes.text: Classic and real parking garages in one script, mode chosen per garage; car, air and sea garages with public, job, gang, private and property access
Impound with a police form, preset and custom fines, hold times, release fees, disputes, auto-tow and abandoned vehicle cleanup
In-game admin panel for garages, interiors, impound lots, vehicle lists and player vehicles, with freecam placement and JSON export / import
Vehicle photo studio: /garagephotos takes transparent vehicle pictures in game, and garage cards show each car in its owner's paint colour
Garage menu with search, sort, filters, favourites, nicknames and GPS; bring vehicles from other garages and return lost ones for a fee
Fuel, engine, body, props and damage (doors, windows, tyres, deformation) are saved and restored
Real parking: vehicles stay in their slots near the player, optional tarps, drive straight out of the slot
Job and gang vehicles with minimum grade, purchase lists paid by the player or the group account, livery and extras on take out
Transfer between garages, give to a nearby player, key sharing with permissions and duration, sell to the dealer or a player
Private garages for sale or rent, and interior garages with cinematic entry, slots and multiple exits
Trailers are stored and restored with their vehicle; optional insurance with offices and durations
/garageimport takes over garages from jg-advancedgarages, tgiann-realparking, qb-garages / qbx_garages and esx garages, with a preview
Works as a drop-in for scripts that call qb-garages, jg-advancedgarages or tgiann-realparking
Auto detected fuel, keys, notify, banking, housing, phone, target, text UI and radial scripts
Discord webhooks for every action, English and Turkish languages
